findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: supplier_compare, documents_tables, merchant_validate, schema_normalize · Private data: supplier_compare, documents_tables, schema_normalize · Public sink: supplier_compare, documents_tables, merchant_validate · Destructive: merchant_validate.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: supplier_compare, documents_tables, merchant_validate, schema_normalize · Private data: supplier_compare, documents_tables, schema_normalize · Public sink: supplier_compare, documents_tables, merchant_validate · Destructive: merchant_validate

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
